name: Object To XML String Converter
helpText:
Object To XML String Converter (Ikasan class: ObjectToXMLStringConverter)

Marshals a plain Java object into an XML string using JAXB. The object's class must be JAXB-annotated (or otherwise buildable into a JAXBContext) - any nested/referenced types it needs must be reachable from its own annotations, since only one root class is supplied here.

Note: this expects the payload to already be the plain object, not a raw JMS message - if the upstream component is a JMS consumer, place a JMS Object Message To Object Converter directly before this one to unwrap the ObjectMessage first.
jarDependencies_comment: ikasan-component-converter (added by the Converter component-type) compiles against jakarta.xml.bind but does not itself declare it as a dependency, so a project depending only on that artifact has no JAXBContext implementation on its classpath at all - both the API and a runtime impl must be added explicitly here.
allowableProperties_comment: Note that the order of properties in this file dictates the order displayed on screen, unless propertyDisplayOrder is set, which will be used as the primary key

componentName.helpText: The name of the component as displayed on diagrams. The name should be unique for the flow. The name will be used internally to reflect the bean created.

objectClass.helpText: The fully qualified, JAXB-annotated class to marshal. JAXBContext is built from this one class, so any other types it references must be reachable from its own JAXB annotations.
objectClass.validationMessage: Provide a fully qualified Java class name, e.g. com.example.MyPojo.

rootClassName.helpText: Override the root element's declared type (QName) - rarely needed unless you want the root tag to reflect a different type than objectClass's own @XmlRootElement.

rootName.helpText: Override the root element's name (QName) - rarely needed unless you want a different root tag name than objectClass's own @XmlRootElement provides.

namespacePrefix.helpText: Namespace prefix to use on the root element (see useNamespacePrefix below) - e.g. 'ns' to render <ns:root xmlns:ns="...">.

namespaceURI.helpText: Namespace URI for the root element's QName.

useNamespacePrefix.helpText: Default(False). Whether to render the root element with the namespacePrefix above rather than a default/no prefix.

validate.helpText: Default(False). Validate the generated XML against schema/schemaLocation below before returning it.

schema.helpText: An alternate schema to validate against, commonly used when the XSD is picked up from the classpath rather than an http resource URL.

schemaLocation.helpText: Schema location URL written into the generated XML's root attribute (xsi:schemaLocation, or xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation if noNamespaceSchema below is set).

noNamespaceSchema.helpText: Default(False). Set when schemaLocation refers to a schema with no target namespace.

routeOnValidationException.helpText: Default(False). When validate above is on: true routes an XML validation failure to the next component instead of throwing and rolling back the transaction.

configuration.helpText: If you don't want to use properties files, you can supply a configuration bean that encapsulates all the properties here which gets bound via Spring @ConfigurationProperties. This might also be useful if you want to extend the configuration with fields the builder doesn't expose. Using it will reduce your ability to configure the component within this tool.
configuration.validationMessage: Provide a java classname for the Configuration bean.

configurationId.helpText: By default, the configuration ID = modulename + flowname + componentName + componentType. There are times when you may wish to override this i.e. if you want multiple flows to share the same configration or you have changed a flow name but don't want to update properties that may have already been stored in the override properties database.

fastFailOnConfigurationLoad.helpText: Default(False). Whether to let the component fail immediately if the initial loading of its configuration fails, rather than deferring the failure.

xmlAdapterMap.helpText: Map of Class to XmlAdapter instance to override the XmlAdapter on the underlying marshaller for specific types.
xmlAdapterMap.validationMessage: Provide a java classname for the bean.
